thread:
maya_sales: Quick sync for Newport Bank POC. They require SAML SSO (Okta & Azure AD), SCIM 2.0 with delta + one-time bulk import, group->role mapping (they rely on nested groups), delegated admin for HR, domain proofing for 6 subdomains, and a predictable monthly provisioning fee for procurement. Also need a short security blurb confirming no passwords stored.

sam_engineer: Product note: SCIM 2.0 + bulk import supported. We flatten nested groups by default to a membership set; if they want hierarchy we can include ancestry metadata (includeNested=true) but that will enlarge payloads. Hosted default SCIM token rate is 200req/s with burst smoothing; Dedicated offers reserved throughput and workers for deterministic latency. Recommend Dedicated or a temporary reserved-throughput add-on for heavy ramp windows.

maya_sales: They expect ~20k employees, ramp 3k the first week, then 800/day. Can someone draft a 2-line purchaser blurb I can paste?

rachel_se: Purchaser blurb: "Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (SP/IdP), SCIM 2.0 with bulk import and delta sync, and IdP group-to-role mappings. For predictable large onboardings we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved provisioning throughput) or Hosted with a provisioning quota add-on; we do not store plaintext passwords or national IDs."

noah_security: Security quick: Confirmed — we never persist plaintext passwords or national identifiers. SCIM attributes (email, externalId, groups, optional attributes) are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and in transit (TLS1.2+). For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK) and can redact optional PII fields on request. We also provide provisioning audit logs.

logan_pricing: Pricing summary: base provisioning tier (covers up to a band of active users) + per-active-user bands thereafter. Ramps can be handled with a temporary reserved-throughput fee or Dedicated commitment. For 20k users they fall in our 10k-25k band; include a 3-week ramp add-on in the quote for the 3k seed. I'll pull exact numbers and send a ballpark.

sam_engineer: Tech snippet for SOW to paste (YAML):

```yaml
provisioning:
  protocol: "SCIM 2.0"
  bulk_import: true
  delta_sync: true
  unique_key: "externalId | userName"
  group_mapping: "idp.group -> app.role (flattened by default; ancestry optional)"
  hosted_default_rate: "200req/s (burst smoothing)"
  dedicated: "reserved throughput + SLA option"
security:
  transport: "TLS1.2+"
  at_rest: "AES-256-GCM"
  kms: "customer-managed optional"
```

maya_sales: Great. Operational asks before I send: sample SCIM export, exact ramp windows (UTC), whether they need SCIM webhooks (we require public endpoint/IP whitelist), and DNS access or admin email for TXT verification.

noah_security: Also request their vendor security questionnaire now. Flag: if they mandate on-prem-only HSM with air-gapped key exchange, that pushes to Private and needs infra planning. Otherwise no blockers.

maya_sales: Thanks all — I'll send purchaser blurb + YAML and request the sample export and questionnaire. Will flag nested-groups follow-up if they push on hierarchy. :pray:
